comment: KOTOR III (fan) Episode 1 ending. Seren and Rhea take the Far Lantern past the charts. Original writing for this fan project.

entries.text: This is it, then. A ship, a navigator, the coordinates, and a crew that came together in two days. I think she would have liked that.
Course is laid in from the recording. Past the last beacon, it is my clans' old lanes or nothing at all. Grab something solid.
entries.speaker: k3_rhea

entries.text: Only that I waited three years for you to walk past my corner of the dock. Ask me again once we are through the jump.
If what we find is worth following. That depends on you more than on them. Now strap in.
entries.speaker: k3_rhea

entries.text: Jumping now. Telos is behind us, and somewhere ahead is the last place she stopped. Let us go and see what she saw.

replies.text: Then let us not waste another minute.
Rhea, will the clans follow where we lead?
